description: Will this model 3D-print? Free check of one of the user's models at a chosen size: verdict (ready / review / fix) with reasons, printed size, material and print time, supports, and the repairs made to get one closed printable solid. The print-ready file (3MF / STL) comes along with a Wandy3D plan, an unlocked model or an API-made model. Takes 30 s – 2 min; may return a task_id for get_task.

format.description: File format of the print file (default 3mf)

length_mm.description: Printed size of the model's longest side in millimetres (30–400, default 150)

model_id.description: model_id of one of the user's models (list_models / get_task)

process.description: fdm = filament printer (default; minimum wall 1.2 mm) or resin (minimum wall 0.6 mm)

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the result before answering with a task_id (0–50 s, default 30)

name: check_print
title: Check a model for 3D printing
